newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 29.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's edition of Daily Variety:

WILMINGTON, Del - Seagram Co Ltd Chief Execuive Officer Edgar Bronfman Jr told the Delaware Chancery Court on Monday that Seagram's MCA Inc would be "strategically disadvantaged" if it sold its 50-percent stake in USA Network to the cable company's co-owner, Viacom Inc. Negotiations over a proposed $1.7 billion sale by MCA of its stake in USA to Viacom collapsed three days ago.

HOLLYWOOD - MCA Inc of Seagram has signed an exclusive long-term, pay-television deal with France's Canal Plus worth an estimated $30 million to $50 million per year. Under terms of the extendable five-year deal, Canal Plus Pay-TV movie service will have exclusive pay rights to Universal Pictures' theatrical product.
